name.text: Find the mistake in a three-set diagram

questiontext.text:
\({@N@}\) learners were asked which of three games they play: {@g1@} (\({@G1@}\)), {@g2@} (\({@G2@}\)) and {@g3@} (\({@G3@}\)). \({@nA@}\) play {@g1@}, \({@nB@}\) play {@g2@} and \({@nC@}\) play {@g3@}. \({@nAB@}\) play {@g1@} and {@g2@}, \({@nAC@}\) play {@g1@} and {@g3@}, and \({@nBC@}\) play {@g2@} and {@g3@}; \({@c@}\) play all three.

{@nm@} filled in a Venn diagram like this:

  • Step 1: all three: \({@c@}\).
  • Step 2: exactly two: \({@G1@}\) and \({@G2@}\) \({@p1@}\), \({@G1@}\) and \({@G3@}\) \({@p2@}\), \({@G2@}\) and \({@G3@}\) \({@p3@}\).
  • Step 3: only: \({@G1@}\) \({@s1@}\), \({@G2@}\) \({@s2@}\), \({@G3@}\) \({@s3@}\).
  • Step 4: none: \({@N@} - {@sev@} = {@z@}\).

(a) Which step is the first one with a mistake?

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

(b) How many play none of the three games?

[[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
(a) {@why@}

The correct working, from the centre out:

  1. Centre: \({@c@}\) play all three.

  2. Exactly two: \({@G1@}\) and \({@G2@}\) only \({@nAB@} - {@c@} = {@r2@}\); \({@G1@}\) and \({@G3@}\) only \({@nAC@} - {@c@} = {@r4@}\); \({@G2@}\) and \({@G3@}\) only \({@nBC@} - {@c@} = {@r6@}\).

  3. Only one: \({@G1@}\) only \({@nA@} - {@r2@} - {@r4@} - {@c@} = {@r1@}\); \({@G2@}\) only \({@nB@} - {@r2@} - {@r6@} - {@c@} = {@r3@}\); \({@G3@}\) only \({@nC@} - {@r4@} - {@r6@} - {@c@} = {@r7@}\).

  4. None: the seven inner regions add up to \({@N-r8@}\), so none \(= {@N@} - {@N-r8@} = {@r8@}\).

  5. Check: \({@G1@}\) \({@r1@} + {@r2@} + {@r4@} + {@c@} = {@nA@}\), and the same for the other two sets.

(b) None of the three: \({@r8@}\).

questiondescription.text:
Sets: finding the mistake in a three-set diagram

Grade 12 CBE Core and Essential 1.1 (d): Find the first wrong step in a learner's centre-out working for a three-set Venn diagram, and give the correct count.

Core and Essential

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).

truefeedback.text: There is a mistake. Check each step against the totals in the question.
Step 1 copies the number who play all three from the question; it is right.

falsefeedback.text: [[if test="is(ans1>er)"]]Step {@ans1@} follows correctly from the steps before it, but there is an earlier mistake. Look earlier.[[else]]Step {@ans1@} is right. Look at the later steps.[[/if]]

truefeedback.text: That is {@nm@}'s value, which comes from the mistake.

falsefeedback.text: Redo the steps: centre, exactly two (pair total \(-\) centre), only, then none.

qtest.description: A later or earlier step; right count
